brand.name: LEAFVA
brand.tagline: IT Intelligence, Powered by Nature and Technology
brand.aesthetic_public: Premium, futuristic, corporate-grade marketing site with high-impact visual storytelling. Tesla-like presence. Dark charcoal background with deep forest green depth and gold highlights. Glassmorphism and bento grids for content.
brand.aesthetic_dashboard: Data-dense, professional ERP. Linear/Notion-like structure but skinned in dark mode with subtle green/gold accents. High contrast text, minimal borders, extremely clean layout.
brand.logo_concept: Stylized leaf combined with tech signature (circuit lines, digital glow). Animated subtly on hover.

hero.animation_concept: Scale-in background image with overlay. Staggered fade-up text. The stylized leaf+circuit logo subtly pulses with a gold glow using Framer Motion.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover transition-colors duration-300 rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.gold_accent: border border-accent_gold text-accent_gold hover:bg-accent_gold/10 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.2)] transition-all rounded-md px-6 py-3
buttons.dashboard_action: bg-surface hover:bg-white/10 text-white rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition-colors border border-border_subtle

cards.marketing_services: Relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border_subtle bg-surface/50 backdrop-blur-sm group hover:border-accent_gold/50 transition-colors duration-500. Add subtle gold gradient blob in background on hover.
cards.dashboard_widget: bg-surface rounded-lg border border-border_subtle shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-2

ai_chat_ui.pattern: Native dockable sliding panel or full-page route. Do NOT use standard widget blobs. Use a sleek command-center style. Background #111111, border-t border-l border-border_subtle.
ai_chat_ui.user_bubble: bg-surface border border-border_subtle text-text_main rounded-2xl rounded-tr-none px-4 py-3
ai_chat_ui.ai_bubble: bg-primary/20 border border-primary/30 text-natural_beam rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none px-4 py-3
ai_chat_ui.input_area: bg-black border border-border_subtle rounded-xl p-2 focus-within:border-accent_gold transition-colors

components.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, chat UI) must have a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming.

hero_background.description: Dark abstract background with deep forest green gradients, wooden beam textures, and glowing gold circuit lines. For marketing Home page hero.

leaf_tech_logo.description: Minimalist stylized leaf symbol integrated with subtle glowing gold circuit board lines. Use as brand logo.

network_abstract.description: Abstract glowing green and gold digital network map. For AI Services / Tech background.

server_room_1.description: Modern data server room. For Networking & Cable Run service card.

server_room_2.description: Woman in contemporary data center. For System Administration service card.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use the provided image URLs to construct the visual identity. The 'leaf_tech_logo' should be placed in the header and hero. Ensure all backgrounds have appropriate overlays (e.g., bg-black/60) to guarantee text contrast.
